title: Teri Meherbaniyan
desc: Ram, an honest man, falls in love with a woman named Bijli and goes on to help the people of her village. However, the region's corrupt leader, Thakur Vijay Singh, soon begins to plot against him.

title: Saugandh
desc: Sarang, an evil landlord, kills Ganga's family. Years later, Shiva, Ganga's son, marries Chand, Sarang's daughter, to seek revenge from Sarang by destroying his ego.

title: Aitraaz
desc: When a company chairman's trophy wife stirs up a storm in a happily married employee's life, the tumultuous winds drag all of them into an intense courtroom showdown.

title: Coolie
desc: Zafar's obsessive love for Salma leads to her separation from her son, Iqbal. Twenty years later, Iqbal strives to reunite with his mother.

title: Himmat
desc: Raghu, a reformed criminal, rescues a woman and soon their love blossoms into a happy marriage. However, when the police arrive to catch him in connection with a murder, their lives turn upside down.
